Welcome to the Global Network Simulator

Build your first network

  1. Rotate the globe and zoom in to one of the labelled locations on the map. Double-click to zoom in quickly.
  2. When the zoom reaches 90%, a Create Business Here button appears. Select it, then select a point on the map.
  3. Enter a business name and choose either Public address block or ISP assigned.

Start building

The simulator opens and you can begin your build.
